post.description: Mark an issue as ready for review, changing its status to Inactive.
Mark an issue as remediated, changing its status from Pending Remediation to Remediated.
Reopen a closed or remediated issue, changing its status back to Open.
Revise an issue, changing its status back to Inactive for further review.
Start the remediation process for an issue, changing its status to Pending Remediation.
